categories.name: Intrinsic / passive fingerprint
categories.description: Traces that arise naturally from a generator (architecture, weights, training, upsampling, decoder, sampling) without an explicitly embedded watermark.

categories.name: Causal fingerprint
categories.description: Model fingerprints formulated through a causal relation provenance -> trace, separated from content and style; evaluated with interventions and counterfactuals.

categories.name: Spectral / frequency fingerprint
categories.description: Cues in energy distribution, transform coefficients, periodic patterns or spectral statistics. Can be an intrinsic cue or a detector feature.

categories.name: Proactive / artificial watermark
categories.description: Signals deliberately embedded for provenance, attribution, ownership or detection.

categories.name: Detector-specific representation
categories.description: Features or embeddings used by a detector or foundation model. Not automatically an intrinsic or causal generator fingerprint.

categories.name: C2PA provenance
categories.description: Signed provenance metadata (Content Credentials). Related to, but not, an intrinsic image fingerprint.

categories.name: External platform classification
categories.description: Labels displayed by third-party platforms. Recorded by the researcher only; never inferred.

terminology_notes: Artifact = jejak/ketidaksempurnaan yang muncul dari proses sintesis atau pipeline generasi.
Fingerprint = representasi atau pola yang relatif stabil dan dapat dipakai untuk membedakan atau mengatribusikan model/source/proses generasi.
Trace = jejak forensik yang tersisa pada output.
Signature = istilah umum untuk pola identitas.
Watermark = sinyal yang sengaja ditanam untuk provenance, attribution, ownership, atau detection.
Detector representation = fitur/embedding yang dipelajari atau digunakan detector. Ini tidak otomatis sama dengan intrinsic fingerprint.
C2PA / Content Credentials = provenance/authenticity infrastructure berbasis metadata dan tanda tangan kriptografis, bukan intrinsic image fingerprint.
